scope: Python bindings; conversion and rendering families
qualification: Implemented routes require supervised integration tests; visual acceptance remains pending Ada's own review.

capabilities.limits: 100 pages, 16MP/page and 64MP/document; native temporary PNG files confined to and cleaned with the disposable work directory.
capabilities.accuracy: Native flatten reconstructs rendered pages on default paper with margins. Source geometry and interactive structure are lost. Requires both explicit acknowledgments, records source/output dimensions and returns partial. Not verified redaction.

capabilities.adapter: PDF Oxide renders each visible page to PNG and embeds it at full-page extent through its native fluent builder. Renderer and PDF writer remain PDF Oxide; engine_fallback=false. PyMuPDF only checks source/output physical dimensions independently, without rendering or writing. Source page boxes, rotation, dimensions and per-page native PNG hashes are retained in the report.
capabilities.limits: 100 pages, 16MP/page, 64MP/document, 16MiB aggregate native PNGs and existing supervised output budget. Native render dimensions must equal requested dimensions. Disagreement with independent physical geometry, including unsupported UserUnit scaling, fails with no output.
capabilities.accuracy: Visible crop and rotation are baked into a zero-origin page of the same displayed physical size; original media/crop box origins, rotation metadata and off-crop content are not retained. Exact embedded-pixel tests prove container retention, not native renderer correctness. Native render diagnostics can still make the result partial. No text/forms/links/signatures or verified redaction. The native flatten_to_images default-paper limitation remains unchanged and its previous failed outputs are preserved.

capabilities.limits: Selected pages <=100; DPI 36..300; 16MP/image and 64MP/input; output budget inherited from supervised worker.
capabilities.accuracy: Rejects requested raster dimensions exceeding the cap rather than accepting upstream silent downscaling. Applicable native operator_cap_exceeded, glyph_dropped or image_suppressed diagnostics make the derivative partial; reports retain raw diagnostics and explicit page/global truncation. Pixel correctness is separately tested. Universal fidelity is unverified.

capabilities.limits: Target box <=4096 pixels per axis and <=16MP. Output dimensions are checked. Upstream fit computes scale from media box even when cropping is present; report preserves actual dimensions.

capabilities.output: Owned raw premultiplied RGBA8888 bytes plus dimensions, stride and source/page/hash provenance. Not mislabeled as straight-alpha RGBA.
PGM coverage bytes (0 no ink, 255 full ink) with original ink names stored only as JSON data; app-owned output filenames.
capabilities.limits: 32 plates/page; direct DeviceCMYK operators are budgeted separately from named resource inks. Native parsing remains under hard process bounds.

capabilities.adapter: Calls in-memory bytes variants and writes only app-owned output paths.
capabilities.limits: Whole document <=250 pages, complete package preflight and inherited output cap. PDF page count is read fallibly before native convenience conversion.
capabilities.accuracy: Reports pinned source's positioned policy <=30 pages for DOCX/PPTX or <=200 for XLSX, flow above. Editable positioned elements are not semantic table cells. Visually reviewed XLSX/PPTX outputs omit the synthetic red vector rectangle and ruled-table borders; when source vector paths are detected the result is partial and records per-page vector counts. DOCX preserved those sampled vectors but remains unqualified. Layout, images, fonts, text and numeric fidelity require independent review.

capabilities.adapter: Explicit format dispatch uses byte snapshots. Path aliases and auto detection map to these same bounded methods.
capabilities.limits: ZIP entry/expanded bytes/ratio/CRC checks, no filesystem extraction, DTD/entity-safe XML with depth/node/text limits, bounded cells/sheets/slides/images. Only PNG/JPEG Office images are accepted until additional formats are qualified. Embedded fonts stay in the package; font licensing is not changed.
capabilities.accuracy: Originals retained; OfficeConverter supplies no structured diagnostic channel, so empty diagnostic lists are explicitly labeled unavailable. No claim that unsupported content was retained.

capabilities.adapter: Verified PNG/JPEG byte snapshots with pixel and byte limits; native bytes constructor only. One source image becomes one output page centered on native default paper/margins. Direct CMYK JPEG embedding is rejected because the independent color test found wrong output. Explicit normalize_cmyk optionally converts to unprofiled RGB PNG and records original/native input hashes; this is not print color certification.
Input order preserved. Native path-only API receives bounded temporary snapshots in the disposable output directory; snapshots are removed after serialization and on errors.
capabilities.limits: 100 inputs; 16MP/image, 64MP total, 16MiB/image and 64MiB aggregate input bytes, inherited output budget.

capabilities.reason: Methods exist in pinned Rust source but not the released Python public binding. The adapter reports native automatic policy; it does not pretend to expose a selectable flow/layout method.
Rust configuration/helpers are absent from the Python public binding. Bounds are external and enforced before/after native calls. Existing app operations retain their existing implementation.

python_convenience_aliases.Page.render: Same native method as PdfDocument.render_page, exposed through oxide_render.
python_convenience_aliases.Page.render_pixmap: Same native method as PdfDocument.render_pixmap, exposed through oxide_render.
python_convenience_aliases.RenderedPixmap: data, width, height are checked, emitted and reported; remaining namedtuple helpers are data protocol.
python_convenience_aliases.SeparationPlate: ink_name, data, width, height are checked, emitted and reported; remaining namedtuple helpers are data protocol.
python_convenience_aliases.OfficeConverter.__new__: Stateless constructor; static conversion dispatch uses the same released class.
python_convenience_aliases.AsyncOfficeConverter: Native sync methods are offloaded by upstream run_in_executor. Existing app supervised async/batch jobs provide bounded scheduling instead of an in-process thread executor.
python_convenience_aliases.AsyncPdf image constructors: Same native constructors through supervised image conversion jobs.
python_convenience_aliases.AsyncPdfDocument rendering and Office me: Same native methods through supervised conversion jobs.

office_thread_workaround.observed_failure: Native DOCX import stalled until the 120-second supervisor timeout.
office_thread_workaround.source_basis: office_oxide 0.1.9 uses a parsing thread when RLIMIT_STACK is below 12MiB; binding holds GIL while joining and Rust logging callbacks may request GIL.
office_thread_workaround.mitigation: Disable native logging callbacks inside the disposable Office import worker. Correct independent DOCX import then completed in 0.38 seconds. Structured Office diagnostics are unavailable, explicitly reported; no claim of complete warnings.

diagnostic_policy.scope: Render, both flatten modes and PDF-to-Office exports retain bounded raw structured_warnings and report explicit partial, truncated, diagnostic_status and omitted_content_categories. Page fields use one-based app numbering; native diagnostic page numbers remain zero-based in raw records.
diagnostic_policy.global_warnings: Native page=null applies conservatively to all selected pages; scoped warnings apply only to the relevant page.
diagnostic_policy.known_loss: operator_cap_exceeded means truncated=true and partial=true. glyph_dropped or image_suppressed also mean partial. no_text_layer means ocr_required=true and partial for text-dependent Office export; raster-only scans remain valid render/flatten input.
diagnostic_policy.actual_regression: A real one-million-operator PDF retains Before cap 012 0.15 and After cap 036 0.00 in an independent reader. Native render, DOCX/XLSX/PPTX export and both flatten modes omit trailing content. These routes previously completed silently despite native diagnostics; regression tests now require partial and preserve the warning. No native cap or acceptance criterion was weakened.
diagnostic_policy.unavailable_channels: Office import and Pdf image constructors still lack a native structured diagnostic channel; their manifests explicitly report that limitation. No absence-of-warning fidelity claim.

independent_output_validation.scope: Every generated PDF from Office import, image-to-PDF and both flatten modes is reopened by PyMuPDF after native validation and before output publication, within the existing bounded worker.
independent_output_validation.checks: Independent page count must agree with native page count; all page rectangles must be nonempty and finite. Explicit preserve_visible_page additionally checks visible source/output physical dimensions. Reports identify the independent parser and explicitly state content_fidelity_checked=false.
independent_output_validation.failure_tests: Fault-injected native success for a truncated PDF and a real two-page PDF falsely reported as one page is rejected by the real independent parser. Existing real supervised conversion tests validate the gate on generated outputs.
independent_output_validation.limits: Structural reopen is not a text, numbers, tables, fonts or visual correctness oracle; PyMuPDF may repair PDFs it can recover. No universal validity or interoperability claim.

verification.visual_review: Conversion agent inspected PDFium-rendered originals and derivatives, including native raster, DOCX, XLSX and PPTX round trips for frozen wrapped/missing/empty-cell tables and prose. Ada's independent acceptance remains pending.
verification.limits_of_office_review: No Microsoft Office or LibreOffice renderer is installed; Office files were independently inspected as OOXML and round-tripped with PDF Oxide before independent PDFium rendering. Successful round trip is not Office interoperability or semantic fidelity certification.
preserved_failures: Direct native CMYK JPEG color corruption
XLSX/PPTX dropped ordinary vectors and ruled table borders
Office parser/logging stall bounded by supervisor timeout
Native operator-cap loss of trailing text and numbers
Native raster font appearance and spacing changes in frozen Courier fixtures
verification.additional_geometry_evidence: evidence/flatten-visible-review-20261016 (new isolated package; previous packages untouched): ten crop/nonzero-origin/rotation cases, mixed fractional sizes, six original frozen experiment fixtures, native operator-cap failure, original/default/explicit PDFs, native PNGs, independent PDFium 72/144-DPI renders, extracted content, pixel metrics and SHA-256 manifest.
verification.geometry_tests: Crop and nonzero origin, rotations 0/90/180/270/-90, mixed fractional physical sizes at 72/144 DPI, PDFium dimensions/corner colors/pixel comparisons, exact retention of every native RGB pixel, unsupported UserUnit rejection and quota cleanup. Numeric 012, 0.15 and -2.00 plus ruled A1/B1/A2/B2 table fixtures; source/output visual acceptance remains separate.
